blocks.raw: # Card Report Notifications
blocks.text: Card Report Notifications

blocks.raw: To accompany the [Card Reports](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/card-reports), there is the ability to have the Daily Auth Window report sent directly as a csv file to a specific email destination so that those who don't have access to the standard reports can still receive this if subscribed to the service.
blocks.text: To accompany the Card Reports, there is the ability to have the Daily Auth Window report sent directly as a csv file to a specific email destination so that those who don't have access to the standard reports can still receive this if subscribed to the service.

blocks.raw: ## Subscribing to Daily Auth Report Notifications
blocks.text: Subscribing to Daily Auth Report Notifications

blocks.raw: Before you are able to receive these notifications you need to ensure that you have requested access to this specific report as detailed in the section [Card Reports](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/card-reports).
blocks.text: Before you are able to receive these notifications you need to ensure that you have requested access to this specific report as detailed in the section Card Reports.

blocks.raw: Once you have access to the report you will need to set up who is to receive these notifications, to complete this you will need to hit either of the two following endpoints (depending if you are a customer or a partner of Modulr):
blocks.text: Once you have access to the report you will need to set up who is to receive these notifications, to complete this you will need to hit either of the two following endpoints (depending if you are a customer or a partner of Modulr):

blocks.raw:
* [Partner Notification Set Up](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/updatenotificationconfigurationsforagivenpartnerandreporttype)
* [Customer Notification Set Up](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/updatenotificationconfigurationsforagivencustomerandreporttype)
blocks.text: Partner Notification Set UpCustomer Notification Set Up

blocks.raw: On each you will need to supply the relevant ID and the report type required along with a list of email address that you wish the notification to be sent to.
blocks.text: On each you will need to supply the relevant ID and the report type required along with a list of email address that you wish the notification to be sent to.

blocks.raw:
> 🚧 Email Addresses
>
> We will not check the validity of the email address, only that its in the correct format so please ensure any email addresses that you use for subscription are correct
blocks.text: Email AddressesWe will not check the validity of the email address, only that its in the correct format so please ensure any email addresses that you use for subscription are correct

blocks.raw: Once successfully subscribed, the report will be sent as a csv file to the email addresses that have been registered, this will be approximately 08:00 UTC.
blocks.text: Once successfully subscribed, the report will be sent as a csv file to the email addresses that have been registered, this will be approximately 08:00 UTC.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Options to access reports
>
> Please note that this report will also be available for access both direct on the API and via the Portal

blocks.raw: ## Amending Daily Auth Window Notifications
blocks.text: Amending Daily Auth Window Notifications

blocks.raw: If you need to make any amendments to who receives the notifications you would first need to hit one of the following endpoints (depending if you are a customer or a partner of Modulr):
blocks.text: If you need to make any amendments to who receives the notifications you would first need to hit one of the following endpoints (depending if you are a customer or a partner of Modulr):

blocks.raw:
* [See Partner Notifications](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/getnotificationconfigurationsforagivenpartnerandreporttype)
* [See Customer Notifications](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/getnotificationconfigurationsforagivencustomerandreporttype)
blocks.text: See Partner NotificationsSee Customer Notifications

blocks.raw: This will return back a list of those that have subscribed to the service, to make amendments either adding or removing, all the email addresses will need to be supplied again by using the same endpoints to originally set up the notifications.
blocks.text: This will return back a list of those that have subscribed to the service, to make amendments either adding or removing, all the email addresses will need to be supplied again by using the same endpoints to originally set up the notifications.

blocks.raw: If you no longer require the report to be sent via an email notification then you can use the following endpoints to delete access for the notification (not the report itself as this will still be on the Portal and the API if required):
blocks.text: If you no longer require the report to be sent via an email notification then you can use the following endpoints to delete access for the notification (not the report itself as this will still be on the Portal and the API if required):

blocks.raw:
* DELETE/partners/`{partnerId}`/card-report-types/`{reportType}`/notifications
* DELETE/customers/`{customerId}`/card-report-types/`{reportType}`/notifications

blocks.text: Pausing Daily Auth Window Notifications

blocks.raw: If you still want to have access to the email notification but want to stop it coming through temporarily you can use the following endpoints, this will pause the email being sent to you until you decide to turn them back on by hitting the same endpoint:
blocks.text: If you still want to have access to the email notification but want to stop it coming through temporarily you can use the following endpoints, this will pause the email being sent to you until you decide to turn them back on by hitting the same endpoint:

> ❗️ Size limitations
>
> Only attachments of a certain size are able to be sent through on emails, if the attachment is too big you will still receive an email but you will be asked to go through to the Portal or API to retrieve it.
